summary: Iteration 9: Comprehensive pre-Apple App Store testing completed. All core features verified working: Legal Disclaimer, Onboarding, Home Calendar (Week/Month), Calculator, Research with AI Search, Journal with health logging, Profile with theme toggle, and Vendor Management. AI Content Safety properly blocks inappropriate queries.
seed_data_creation: Test data created through existing tests - BPC-157 recurring items, Test Peptide Supplier vendor
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is ready for Apple App Store submission. All critical features tested: 1) Legal Disclaimer modal requires checkbox acceptance before app access, 2) Onboarding can be skipped, 3) Home screen shows Week/Month calendar toggle with date selection, 4) Calculator computes peptide dosages (tested: syringe selection, vial amount, dose = 6.0 units), 5) Research tab has AI Web Search with content safety (blocks inappropriate queries like 'how to make drugs'), 6) Journal has comprehensive health logging (weight, energy, sleep, mood, gym activity with duration/intensity), 7) Profile has Light/Dark theme toggle and Privacy Policy link, 8) Vendor Management accessible from nav menu and Profile. All 59 backend tests pass including AI content safety tests.

features_verified.legal_disclaimer: PASS - Modal shows on first launch, requires checkbox acceptance, Continue button properly disabled until accepted
features_verified.onboarding: PASS - Shows after disclaimer, can be skipped with Skip button
features_verified.home_calendar: PASS - Week/Month toggle works, today's date highlighted, schedule items displayed
features_verified.peptide_calculator: PASS - Syringe size selection, vial amount, BAC water, dose calculation working (tested: 6.0 units result)
features_verified.research_ai_search: PASS - AI Web Search modal, valid queries return results, inappropriate queries properly blocked
features_verified.ai_content_safety: PASS - Blocks drug manufacturing, explicit content, violence, jailbreak attempts
features_verified.journal_logging: PASS - Log Entry modal with weight, energy (1-10), sleep quality, hours slept, mood, gym activity, duration, intensity, notes
features_verified.profile_theme: PASS - Light/Dark toggle working, dark mode properly applied
features_verified.privacy_policy: PASS - Privacy Policy link present in Profile
features_verified.vendor_management: PASS - Accessible from nav menu, shows vendors list with Orders tab
features_verified.navigation_dropdown: PASS - Menu shows Home, Calculator, Research, Journal, Profile, Vendor Management
